caseNameFull: Rogoway v. Warden, U. S. Penitentiary, McNeil Island, Washington
attorneys: Ted Bogoway, pro se. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Berge, and Messrs. Oscar A. Provost and W. Marvin Smith for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, and motion for leave to proceed further in forma pauperis, denied.
